# GUI Interface Description

## System Header Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" button
- **Center**: "Files" label
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 23:58"
  - System notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Background
- Abstract geometric wallpaper with gradient from deep purple to red-orange
- Central abstract design resembling flowing fabric or feathers

## Left Sidebar (Dock)
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - File manager icon (folder)
  - Ubuntu Software icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Trash icon
  - Grid icon (application launcher)

## File Manager Window
### Window Title Bar
- **Left**: Back and forward navigation arrows
- **Center**: Home icon and "Home" label
- **Right**: 
  - Three-dot menu button
  - Search magnifying glass icon
  - View options button (list view icon)
  - Window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close)

### Left Navigation Panel
- **Top Section**:
  - "Recent" with clock icon
  - "Starred" with star icon
  - "Home" with house icon (highlighted)
- **Middle Section**:
  - "Desktop" with folder icon and tooltip "Open your personal folder"
  - "Documents" with document icon
  - "Downloads" with download icon
  - "Music" with music note icon
  - "Pictures" with image icon
  - "Videos" with video camera icon
  - "Trash" with trash can icon
- **Bottom Section**:
  - "Other Locations" with plus icon

### Main Content Area
- **Grid Layout** of files and folders
- **Top Row**:
  - Desktop (folder icon with gradient)
  - Documents (folder with document icon)
  - Downloads (folder with download icon)
  - Music (folder with music note icon)
  - Pictures (folder with image icon)
  - Public (folder with share icon)
  - requirements.txt (text file icon)
- **Second Row**:
  - server (folder icon)
  - snap (folder icon)
  - Templates (folder icon)
  - Videos (folder icon)
  - .bash_history (text file icon)
  - .bash_logout (text file icon)
  - .bashrc (text file icon)
- **Third Row**:
  - .cache (folder icon)
  - .config (folder icon)
  - .gnupg (folder icon)
  - .ipython (folder icon)
  - .lesshst (text file icon)
  - .local (folder icon)
  - .mozilla (folder icon)
- **Fourth Row**:
  - .pki (folder icon)
  - .profile (text file icon)
  - .selected_editor (text file icon)
  - .ssh (folder icon)
  - .sudo_as_admin_successful (text file icon)
  - thunderbird (folder icon)
  - .var (folder icon)
- **Fifth Row**:
  - .viminfo (text file icon)
  - .vscode (folder icon)

## Desktop Icons
- **Bottom Right Corner**:
  - "CPD_Background_Inv..." (PowerPoint file icon)
  - "Home" (folder icon)
